strategy: Digital PR / linkable-asset outreach for the Subnautica 2 Evidence Guide. The site is a fan-made, unaffiliated, source-attributed (wiki revision links) reference. Highest-leverage backlink targets are communities that already value verified data: the wiki, Reddit subs, and Discord. Gaming media is lower priority (harder, needs a newsworthy angle). All outreach is manual relationship work — this file is the tracking source of truth; the companion data/backlink-tracker.json records status.

tadpole-calculator.pitch: Source-linked Tadpole build calculator — pick a chassis and depth modules, see total crafting inputs, max depth, and speed. Embeddable via iframe.

vehicle-planner.pitch: Wiki-revision-attributed Tadpole recipes, fragment counts, chassis, and depth-module ratings in one view.

starter-planner.pitch: Start-here crafting planner with dependency graph and documented fragment requirements.

targets.name: Subnautica 2 Wiki (wiki.subnautica.com)
targets.contact: Wiki editor community / 'Community portal' or discussion page. We already attribute them (CC BY-NC-SA); propose a reciprocal 'fan tools' mention on a relevant page or external-links section.
targets.notes: Lowest-friction high-trust target. They are the primary data source; a courteous note offering the attributed reference as a complement (not replacement) can earn a link from a tools/resources section.

targets.name: r/Subnautica
targets.contact: Modmail for sidebar/community-resources link; otherwise share the calculator in 'help' threads (already an active acquisition channel — 51% of Reddit ref traffic).
targets.notes: Already driving traffic. A persistent sidebar/community-resources link is the prize; short-term, dropping the calculator in answer threads compounds the existing loop.

targets.name: r/Subnautica_2
targets.contact: Modmail for sidebar/community-resources link; share calculator in relevant threads.
targets.notes: The game's dedicated sub. Highest intent audience. Same playbook as r/Subnautica.

targets.name: Subnautica Official Discord
targets.contact: Ask in #guides or #sn2-discussion (or a moderator) whether a fan-tools resource can be pinned/linked. Share the calculator directly in help channels.
targets.notes: Discord embeds Open Graph cards — the calculator's og:image makes shares pop. Strong for real-time help answers.

targets.name: Subnautica 2 YouTube creators
targets.contact: Comment or community-post the calculator as a free resource; some creators link tools in video descriptions.
targets.notes: Manual, slower. Target creators doing 'beginner build' / 'crafting guide' videos. A 'free interactive build calculator' is a genuinely useful description link.

targets.name: Steam Subnautica 2 community guides
targets.contact: Link the calculator/reference from a Steam community guide you author or contribute to.
targets.notes: Author a short Steam guide that links back to the source-attributed reference. Owns the linking page.

targets.name: Gaming blogs / 'best Subnautica 2 tools' listicles
targets.contact: Pitch the interactive calculator as a unique fan-made tool worth a mention in a roundup. Needs a newsworthy/niche angle; lowest conversion.
targets.notes: Highest effort, lowest yield for a new DR~0 site. Revisit after the calculator earns a few community links and has social proof.
